notes.title: A Mini-Update to celebrate the Cat Cafe Manager 2 Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

We've just launched the [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2]Kickstarter campaign[/url][/b] to help fund Cat Cafe Manager 2's development, and we couldn't be more excited!! ❤️It would help us a lot if you could [b]back the campaign[/b] as soon as you can, as the first hours are the most important! Thanks so much!!❤️

To celebrate, we're launching a little mini-update for Cat Cafe Manager 1!

[h3]Introducing: [b]Faeline Lore[/b]![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/c7a5f6710bb0c436396f36eb124f87c8dbb8bb5b.png[/img]
This old repository of ancient lore will [b]significantly raise your cafe's Book Score[/b], which I know has been a tough stat to boost up 'till now! You can purchase Faeline Lore at the [b]Decoration section[/b] of the [b]Furniture Shop[/b]! It's not exactly cheap, but definitely worth it!

But what is a [b]Faeline[/b], exactly? In short, they're adorable little feline faeries. They haven't been seen by humans in many years, but cats see and interact with them all the time. Faeline will also feature prominently in the sequel, [b]Cat Cafe Manager 2[/b]! Check out the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2]Kickstarter page[/url] for more details!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/90fb46bfb617fcdc5b64f2e4832548e47ed4486e.png[/img][/url]

Finally, I want to give a [b]massive thank you[/b] to you, the players of Cat Cafe Manager 1!
Without you playing and supporting the game, we never could have started production on a sequel. We're dedicated to make it bigger, better and fluffier without losing the cozy cafe experience you've come to love! ❤️

Again, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2]please take a look at the Kickstarter[/url], and if you can, help support the development of Cat Cafe Manager 2 by backing.

Thanks so much!
- Rick (and all of Roost Games

notes.title: Cat Cafe Manager 2 : July Monthly Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Here’s our monthly update!

Last month we announced that we are working on a sequel of our first game, called [b]Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss[/b], and we are running a Kickstarter campaign in September! We reached 1000 followers in less than 3 weeks!! So exciting!! Thanks so much everyone!! 😱

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/65ed9b5613689e1d7bc36b033cd95dd8fa80581b.png[/img][/url]

Remember that Kickstarter works a bit like Steam: the more followers we can get before it launches, the better the algorithm likes us, the better chances we have of the campaign becoming a big success! So please [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2]give us a follow[/url] and let your friends know, if you haven’t done so yet! 😺

[i]By the way, something important to keep in mind is that when the campaign goes live in September, in order to pledge and support us [b]you must use a debit or credit card[/b] associated with Visa, Discover, JCB, MasterCard, UnionPay, or American Express. [b]Kickstarter does not currently accept Maestro or Visa Electron cards[/b], PayPal or Klarna. Please keep this in mind in case you don’t have a debit or credit card yet, so that you might be able to order one before the campaign goes live. Or maybe you can lend you one from a friend to help you out with their card! (That’s what I do). You can find more detail about payment options [url=https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005066433-What-forms-of-payment-can-I-use-to-make-a-pledge]here[/url]. 🙏[/i]

[h3]Call Me, Maybe?[/h3]
It was so exciting for everyone in the team to finally reveal what we’re working on and show the key art of our next game! How do you like it, and did you have a closer look at all the small details?

Especially keen-eyed viewers of the Cat Cafe Manager 2 art might notice your main character holding something... a smartphone! Gone are the days of having to walk over to your pay-phone every day. With this newfangled gadget, you can do all kinds of neat stuff!

Here's a sneak-peek image of an early design for the phone menu. Using your smartphone, you can access different kinds of menus or look up handy info.
And what a cute accessory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/4189c13c3b27cc26fff6dd3a6f4c75cab98f092a.png[/img]

[i][b]Please note:[/b] none of what's presented here is final, including the design, as well as the buttons that are present on the smartphone. Thanks for understanding.[/i]

[h3]Introducing The Cat Cafe Team![/h3]

Today I also wanted to present to you our team. We're currently working very hard on Cat Cafe Manager 2 and preparing the Kickstarter campaign, so that we will be able to show you the first images next month, stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/27227ab1a17c7fdbd757d7e0d249c60a737badd1.png[/img]
[i][b]Rick[/b] first saw a cat cafe in 2013 during his exchange study in Kyoto and couldn't help but think "heck, this might make for a good game!". 7 years and 3 released games later (look for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/abbeygames]Abbey Games[/url]) he started Roost Games to finally make that cat cafe game! Rick's the game designer and story person on Cat Cafe Manager, and the Creative Director on Cat Cafe Manager 2. He might be addicted to board games, and won't let his allergies stop him from petting every dog and cat he lays his eyes on.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/2f5143235117c6ee3947f236fb7b5ac4fa2d92e9.png[/img]
[i][b]Carmen[/b] has been a part of Roost Games since the very beginning in 2020 and worked on Cat Cafe Manager as an art director, artist and animator. She’s worked as an artist/animator on several indie titles such as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/296970/Renowned_Explorers_International_Society/]Renowned Explorers[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1875060/Reus_2/]Reus 2[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1487630/Tracks_of_Thought/]Tracks of Thought[/url]. She’s a big time Sailor Moon fan and is still waiting for the day a talking cat tells her she has magical moon powers.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/1dca132470b5a4de9de443bcc3adf286899a3c35.png[/img]
[i][b]Joni[/b] has been part of Roost Games since 2020 and as a producer and business developer he usually only plays a small part, but in a lot of different things. In the past he also made music, and besides music and games he loves Legos, good food, and cats of course - although he is sadly in between cats at the moment…[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/eb3ee0c383b728f9bfe87d4c9cf2d4dc7667ae17.png[/img]
[i][b]Esmeé[/b] is a Game Artist/Designer and advocate for the cozy games genre. She directed the 2.5D game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1487630/Tracks_of_Thought/]Tracks of Thought[/url] where she worked with some of the Cat Cafe Manager 2 crew before! Now as one of their freelancers she’s responsible for all the bits, pieces and buttons making up the interface for the game as well as helping with marketing efforts. She takes great pride in befriending all the cats in her neighbourhood and hopes to save a bee with some sugar water someday.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/2d1c990a7bd3674e142c1693bbdc570ce10cb443.png[/img]
[i][b]Ernst[/b] is a long time collaborator and since 2024 officially part of Roost Games. As the main game programmer for Cat Cafe Manager 2, he makes sure all the game design ideas and art are transformed into a real game. Besides programming and playing games, he likes to cook, read fantasy novels and is a bit of a coffee snob. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/f6b0984deb3ad36911edaaae680c009b97ed7787.png[/img]
[i][b]Mischa[/b] is a game artist working in both 2D and 3D. He also made a tiny game called ‘[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2494720/Little_Man_Has_a_Day/]Little Man has a Day[/url]’ so he can call himself a gamedev as well. As a freelancer working on Cat Cafe Manager 2, he was responsible for turning Carmen’s 2D drawings and designs into 3D objects. When he’s not behind his computer making things, he dabbles in amateur theater, but would never admit that on the internet.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/004e6ceed03d152516d00b99581d11f87db2f6f2.png[/img]
[i][b]Sonya[/b] is a musician, game composer and cat-fan. She officially joined roost games 2 years ago after working on Cat Cafe Manager as a freelancer. She’s been making music in very many shapes and forms, playing on big music festivals as a bass player, recording bands as an engineer and even scoring a theater piece using all sound of a piano except for the piano keys. Sonya has had a lot of long conversations with her cat Vosje about how cat music should sound so she’s really looking forward to putting all this new information into practice![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/6f9e08cefad7d1c041744dbdb67fcac890a0c1a8.png[/img]
[i][b]Tim[/b] joined Roost Games as a freelancer earlier this year and is taking care of the tech art, meaning he's creating effects and tools to make the game prettier! He has his own indie game studio, where he created [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2429090/Garden_Buddies/]Garden Buddies[/url] and the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3028560/Footsy/]Footsy[/url], and has also helped on the game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1487630/Tracks_of_Thought/]Tracks of Thought[/url]. He loves playing music, is obsessed with Japanese monster movies, and loves to make pretty shaders! One of his first 3D models was actually (a VERY rough) model of his childhood cat! [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/13968252cfeb700bad8251a3751ede8880d02c20.png[/img]
[i][b]Irene[/b] joined Roost Games earlier this year to take care of Marketing and Community, she worked on the indie games [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158220/Kraken_Academy/]Kraken Academy[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1207650/Suzerain/]Suzerain[/url] before. She sadly has no cats due to allergies, but has a lot of plants instead! 🌱[/i]

[h3]Let's Wrap Up[/h3]
By the way, we’re working on reactivating our Reddit community server, so if you are redditor, [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/catcafemanager/]come join us[/url] and share your thoughts with us! You can also find us on [url=https://x.com/roostgames?lang=en]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/catcafemanager/?hl=en]Instagram[/url] and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sAXW2mx]Discord Community[/url].

Thank you so much!!!  Our next reveal will be early next month, can’t wait to show you!

Take care! ✨❤️
Rick

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.492
notes.notes:
Hi there! A quick hotfix here to fix some bugs reported by the community.

- Fixed an issue where Customers get stuck in the corner of the map instead of entering the cafe.
- Fixed an issue where the "You can call a Regular" notification got stuck if you tried to call a Regular after the cafe is closed.

If you run into anything while playing, definitely let us know (preferably by making a ticket on our discord, but anyway is fine!).

Thanks so much for playing Cat Cafe Manager!
Rick

notes.title: Update #3: The Naptime Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/5460590571dd1ecc6e648dbeea8d136ef8ae7b70.png[/img]

Blankies at the ready? Hot water bottle stuffed under your pillows?
Alright then. Ready. Set... 💤[b]Naptime[/b]💤!

This surprisingly energetic major update bring [b]sleeping cats[/b], a new [b]furniture set[/b] and [b]ingredient delivery[/b]! Let's dive in.

🐱[i]Points with this icon were Community Suggestions![/i]

[h2]NEW FEATURE: 💤Sleepy Cats[/h2]
🐱Adding a new [b]Cat Need[/b]: [b]Sleep[/b].

At the [b]end of each workday[/b] cats with the Sleep Need (all cats after the first upgraded Stray Cat Lure) will want to [b]sleep in a cat bed[/b].

The 2 [i]Cat Litterbox[/i] Shrine upgrades have been changed to [b]'Cat Comforts'[/b], and now include [b]6 cat[/b] beds to unlock. Place these in your cafe for your cats to sleep in; but higher Sleep Need cats want better beds!

Cats that [b]cannot sleep in a bed[/b] because your bed score isn't high enough will [b]complain[/b] instead. The following day these cats will be [b]unavailable[/b] for 3 to 5 hours as they [b]sleep during the day[/b]. Better get them their catnap!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/6c2cdb547acd99d2d36250f395463f7f4e17d3fe.png[/img]

[h2]NEW FEATURE: 📦Bonner's Ingredient Delivery Service[/h2]
🐱Have your [b]ingredients delivered[/b]!
Complete the game [i](by finishing all the Shrine Upgrades)[/i] to unlock Bonner's newly provided service!

Once unlocked, you can purchase the new Delivery Service at the [b]Food Market[/b] shop.
After purchasing, click the [b]🔁button[/b] next to an Ingredient at the Food Market shop to turn on [b]'auto delivery'[/b]. Once turned on, you will automatically purchase that ingredient whenever you run out! If you cannot afford it at this time, the game will give you a little notification, and turn off the auto delivery for now.

[h2]NEW CONTENT: ⛩️Eastern Teahouse Furniture Set[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/6a2eeb2858fac4001b52f5a950b6685243107d53.png[/img]
This new [b]high level[/b] furniture set includes tables, chairs, wallpapers, floors, kitchen utensils and decor that will allow you to turn your cat cafe into a beautiful teahouse, inspired by Chinese and Japanese designs.

We hope you'll use these to build a beautiful cafe!

[h2]MORE![/h2]
[list]
[*][b]CONTENT:[/b] New 🌺 outdoor plant decorations:
- Tulips [i](purchasable from the start)[/i]
- Bush [i](purchasable from the start)[/i]
- Sunflowers [i](unlocked in the Harvest Halloween Shrine Upgrade)[/i]
- Cat shaped bush [i](unlocked in the Tea House 1 Shrine Upgrade)[/i]
[*]🐱[b]CONTENT:[/b] Added 7 new 💇🏽hairstyles!
Remember you can change your hairstyle by  pressing ESC and selecting 'Edit Character'.
[*][b]FEEDBACK[/b]: More clear feedback on what stats get affected by having duplicates of a piece of furniture, when buying in the shop.
[*][b]FEEDBACK[/b]: Cats that are not available to entertain customers for any reason [i](because they are asleep or complaining about stress / playing)[/i] are now colored darker to indicate this a bit more.
[*][b]FEEDBACK[/b]: Cats complaining about wanting to play [i](because there are not enough Toys)[/i] now use their 'play' animations, to differentiate from complaining about wanting pets.
[*][b]FEEDBACK[/b]: New end of game text explains your newly unlocked options a bit more clearly, including your ability to re-adopt any cats you’ve given a Forever Home.
[*]🐱[b]FIX[/b]: Robocat9000 will not complain about food anymore.
[*]🐱[b]FIX[/b]: Cats who complain about wanting to Play or be Pet no longer slide around the cafe.
[*][b]FIX[/b]: Cats can no longer have multiple ‘Play’ or ‘Calm’ tasks anymore.
[*][b]FIX[/b]: Improved the language system when changing languages between saves.
[/list]

We really really hope you enjoy the update!
I put this in our update announcement, but I think it'd be good to repeat here:
[h3]The Naptime Update will be the final major update for Cat Cafe Manager.[/h3]

To be clear, this [b]won't mean we'll stop fixing bugs and issues[/b] that come up!
It's just that we've started prototyping and developing really exciting [b]new games[/b] to work on beyond CCM, and we're now at a point in development that we've gotta focus our small team's attention on them full-time.

I can't yet talk about these new games, but I can guarantee we'll keep doing what we do best: make [b]wholesome & interesting management games[/b]! We'll post [url=https://discord.com/invite/5dCbC895hs]on the Roost Games discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/roostgames]twitter[/url] once we can show stuff off!

Again, we really hope you enjoy the update. If you run into anything, or have any feedback, definitely let us know, OK? Until next time!

From me (Rick) and all of Roost Games (Rutger, Carmen, Joni and Sonya)...
[b]thanks so much for playing our little cat game![/b]

notes.title: THANK YOU! 1 Year Anniversary & Announcing next Major Update
notes.notes:
Hullo again, cat enthusiasts!

First of all...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/b7548178e93cec54dcf1d88e2b28c3f6795f0128.png[/img]

It's the [b]1 year anniversary of Cat Cafe Manager[/b], and what a year!
When we started Roost Games at the start of 2020, I had no idea that 3 years later our first self-developed game would be so supported by a community of terrific cat lovers! And I, and the rest of Roost Games, feel so incredibly thankful for that!!

So, like Mateo said above, [b]THANK YOU[/b] for playing Cat Cafe Manager!

We released a [b]mini update[/b] today, which...
[list]
[*] Adds some fresh 🎉 anniversary flair to the main menu
[*] Fixes a rare issue where the Premium Cat Lure wouldn't be in the shop after unlocking it
[/list]
... but something much bigger is coming!

[h1]The next major update releases [u]April 27[/u]![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/5460590571dd1ecc6e648dbeea8d136ef8ae7b70.png[/img]

The [b]Naptime Update[/b] will introduce a bunch of new stuff, like...
[list]
[*] [b]New Cat Need: 💤Sleep[/b]. Finally, you can buy your cats a cardboard box to sleep in.
[*] [b]New High-Level Furniture Set: ⛩️Eastern Teahouse[/b]. Build a new kind of dazzling cat cafe.
[*] [b]New Quality of Life feature: 📦Ingredient Delivery[/b]. Out of ingredients? Just have them delivered!
[*] [b]And more![/b]
[/list]
Here's a little sneak peak at some of the new furniture from the Eastern Teahouse set:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/2336b671d43e5f5a56b9fb2de940f6e3ec82d05f.png[/img]

I do have one more bittersweet thing to announce:
[h3]The Naptime Update will be the final major update for Cat Cafe Manager.[/h3]

To be clear, this [b]won't mean we'll stop fixing bugs and issues[/b] that come up!
It's just that, while developing new content for Cat Cafe Manager over the past year, we've also started prototyping and developing really exciting [b]new games[/b] to work on beyond CCM, and we're now at a point in development that we've gotta focus our small team's attention on them full-time.

I can't yet talk about these new games, but I can guarantee we'll keep doing what we do best: make [b]wholesome & interesting management games[/b]! We'll post [url=https://discord.com/invite/5dCbC895hs]on the Roost Games discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/roostgames]twitter[/url] once we can show stuff off!

Alright, that's it for now! I hope you look forward to the [b]Naptime Update on April 27[/b]!

From me (Rick) and all of Roost Games (Rutger, Carmen, Joni and Sonya)...
[b]thanks so much again!! We could never have done it without each and every one of you![/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.466
notes.notes:
[b]Hi again cat lovers![/b]
Here's a patch with a bunch of fixes to issues we found and encountered by the community.
We're still working on [b]another update with new content[/b]. It's gonna take a bit longer but I hope you're looking forward to it!

Oh, and while you're here, we have a little request: We're trying to hit 1,000 reviews by our 1-year anniversary on April 14th, so we'd love to hear your thoughts! If you haven't reviewed us already, we'd really appreciate it if you took a couple of minutes to do so, it really helps people find our cozy lil game! We really appreciate every single review! Thanks!! 🐱

🐱[i]Points with this icon were Community Suggestions or bug reports![/i]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list][*]Removed the winter theme on main menu[/list]
[h3]General fixes:[/h3]
[list][*] 🐱 Wall mounted decorations are always considered 'passable' and no longer block AI pathfinding.
[*] 🐱 Hiring the post-game staff & re-adopting Forever Home cats now spends the resources they require.
[*] Fixed build cost of outside floors incorrectly showing as '0' even when it's not.
[*] Can now properly attach Wall mounted decorations when turned left or right
[*] 🐱 The game will now automatically remove wall mounted decorations when a wall is removed, so they no longer float in mid-air.
[*] 🐱 Fixed a rare issue of time getting stuck when cancelling certain UI’s using the ESC key.
[*] 🐱 Fixed a rare crash when skipping to morning.[/list]
[h3]Controller fixes:[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed bug where you could open a shop while already being in the shop with a controller
[*] Fixed some selection issues in the Shrine if using a controller.
[*] Changed cancelling the 'move furniture mode' to B on a controller.
[*] Changed continuing the end of shift to A on a controller.[/list]
Here's a little tease for something new in the next update! 🐱💤
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/5dae12cc8b03126802d428849917c05a2962dc47.png[/img]
Thanks!
- Rick

notes.title: Holiday Mini-Update!
notes.notes:
Merry Holidays Cat Enthusiasts!
I hope Cat Cafe Manager gave you some fun, some cozy, and lots of cat this year!

I also want to give a big hearty thank you to all of you that've played Cat Cafe Manager, shared your reactions, feedback, funny stories and cat pics on the Steam forums and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/5dCbC895hs]community Discord[/url]!!

This is the first time us at Roost Games have released our own game. It's been a tough and stressful year here and there, but you all truly made this a year to remember for us - from the bottom of our hearts, [b]thank you[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/008aabbe2760802481deffdf603aa464e708a4a2.png[/img]

As a little thank-you gift as we go into the holidays, here's a holiday mini-update, which adds:
[list]
[*] A new piece of furniture: The🎄[b]Winterfest Tree[/b]!
Buy this at the Plant section of the Furniture shop to bring the cozy holiday vibes to your cat cafe!
[*] Some holiday cheer for the main menu!
[/list]
We've got a bigger update planned sometime early next year, so I hope you look forward to that!

Once again, from everyone at Roost Games, thanks so much!!
We sincerely hope you've enjoyed your time with our little cat game!🐱

- Rick (and Rutger, Sonya, Joni and Carmen)

PS. If you've enjoyed Cat Cafe Manager, leaving a review would mean the world to us. Thanks!!

notes.title: Update #2: Harvest Stories
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/58cb8935ab807cfe684768d0e40945fd27ed8727.png[/img]
Trick or Treat??
Let's go with [b]treat[/b], as you treat yourself with 🎃[b]Harvest Stories[/b]🎃, the second major update for Cat Cafe Manager!

This spoopy update is all about adding [b]more story[/b] and [b]taking your cat cafe outside[/b]!

🐱[i]Points with this icon were Community Suggestions![/i]

[h1]NEW FEATURE: Friendship Furniture[/h1]
🐱More story! Adding over 17.000 words of more story to Cat Cafe Manager!

As you reach the [i]3rd Shrine renovation event[/i], you will meet a new character, [b]Hoover[/b], who opens the [b]Curiosities Shop[/b], where you can buy 💚[b][i]Friendship Furniture[/i][/b], a new type of furniture.

Place 💚[b][i]Friendship Furniture[/i][/b] in your cat cafe, and your friends the Regulars will sometimes come over to hang! Telling 👻[b]ghost stories[/b] over the [b]Campfire[/b], playing ⚔️[b]Kittens & Kaverns[/b] at the [b]Game Table[/b], or learning more about the valley's history at 📚[b]Gran's Photo Book[/b] are just some examples of the many new stories you can experience!

[h1]NEW FEATURE: Build Outside[/h1]
🐱Build outside! Take your cat cafe [b]outside[/b] with the new 🌲[i][b]Outside Floor Tiles[/b][/i].

These new floor tiles allow you to [i]place furniture outside[/i]. Have your guests enjoy a cat's companionship out there in calm mother nature. These new furniture sets are perfect for building outside. Speaking of which...

[h1]NEW CONTENT: Furniture Sets[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Furniture Set: 🎃[b]Spooky Harvest[/b]!
Bring spooky season to your cat cafe with this new furniture set! Use spooky decorations to celebrate halloween, or have your guests chill outside amongst the cornfields and freshly harvested crops.
[*] New Furniture Set: 🏖️[b]Summer Beach[/b]!
This new furniture set is perfect for giving your cafe those summery vibes, or building a relaxing outdoor picnic hang for your guests and cats.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/f59bda4327a2bc66338de174bc60d9f3b34b59a4.png[/img]

[h1]MORE![/h1]
[list]
[*] 🐱[b]FEATURE[/b]: Added a re-adopt button to the cat roster, allowing you to take cats back in after the main story has finished.
[*] 🐱[b]BALANCE[/b]: Eased up recipe and ingredient cost in the late game.
[*] [b]FIX[/b]: Fixed visual bug with the diner floor
[*] [b]FIX[/b]: Added potential fix for red walls/furniture sometimes popping up after playing a long time
[*] [b]FIX[/b]: Fixed crash with some ghost furniture messing up save games
[*] [b]FIX[/b]: Added missing Diner tag for Deep Frier and Stove
[*] [b]FIX[/b]: Fixed crash when switching shop tabs right after entering a shop
[/list]

notes.title: Update #1: The Comfy Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/ef323603df9d868b5cc474a9aab2c01ea7e732ae.png[/img]

Hullo there!
Are your feet up? Is your blankie all the way up to your chin? Hot coco and a purring cat nearby?
That's right, get comfy for the ✨[b]Comfy Update[/b]✨, the first big update for Cat Cafe Manager!

[h1]The Comfy Update[/h1]
First of all, I want to quickly thank each and every one of you that played Cat Cafe Manager! It's been a dream come true for us, a tiny 4 person studio, to see you enjoying the game, and telling us how you feel about it.
On that note, I also really want to thank everyone that shared [b]feedback[/b], [b]suggestions[/b] and [b]bug reports[/b] with us on our [b][url=https://discord.gg/5dCbC895hs]Discord[/url][/b] and the [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1354830/discussions/]Steam forum[/url][/b]! It's been sooo helpful in determining what we can do to make Cat Cafe Manager a more relaxing, comfy experience for you!

This update is all about [b]quality of life[/b]! Giving you the tools to play CCM better and easier.
Let's comfortably slide right into the patch notes, shall we?

🐱 [i]Points with this icon were [b]Community Suggestions[/b]![/i]

[h2]NEW FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🐱 You can now [b]sell[/b] your unwanted furniture in Decorate Mode!
[i]In the Decorate UI, select the piece of furniture you want to sell, and click the blue 'Sell' box. You'll get back 25% of the price you paid for the furniture![/i]
[*] 🐱 You can now select [b]which tasks[/b] a Staff member will perform.
[i]You can set them in the 'detail screen' for a Staff Member by checking or unchecking the little box next to a skill. This allows you to focus Staff Members on only serving customers, or only cooking food.[/i]
[*] 🐱 Added new Traits for Staff members which unlock the Cat Care and Maintenance skills.
[*] 🐱 You can now edit your character and cafe name while playing.
[i]Simply press ESC to go to the menu, which now has 2 new options: Edit Character & Edit Cafe Name.[/i]
[*] Added a new Gameplay option to [b]single press[/b] a key/button instead of holding it to perform actions.
[i]Go to Settings > Game, and tick the 'Tap to Perform Task' box there.[/i]
[/list]
[h2]UI ADDITIONS[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🐱 The Autosave file now [b]includes the player name[/b] so you can have Autosaves of multiple games, and the game warns you if you start a game with the same name, to prevent accidentally overwriting it.
[*] When a Customer Group levels up (after getting a Friendship Level with a Regular) a [b]new screen[/b] will tell you what their new rewards and Needs are.
[*] 🐱 Added [b]arrow keys[/b] as valid control option for moving your character and camera for left-handed players.
[*] Food Menu UI now displays your recipe inventory and the [b]recipes you're currently missing[/b] that your customers sometimes want to order.
[*] 🐱 The Cat Roster UI now shows your[b] total score[/b] per Customer Group, so you can more easily determine which Customers will be happy with your cat roster.
[*] You can now open the Cat Roster UI when petting stray cats.
[*] 🐱 The Advertising UI now shows all the Needs and desired recipes of customers.
[*] Clearer indication when a Stray Lure [b]cannot attract more Strays[/b], and that Lure is removed from the shop. You'll also automatically get a refund on any Lures you own that can no longer attract Strays.
[*] 🐱 Added icons for[b] furniture style [/b]to the Shop and Decorate Mode, so you can see how much of a style you own.
[*] 🐱 Added sorting options to the Shop UI. Sort based on name [i](A>Z)[/i], price [i](low>high)[/i], furniture style or amount owned [i](least>most)[/i].
[*] 🐱 Added a number of how many of an ingredient you own in the Ingredient Shop, so you can more easily add the ones you need. [i](Tip: sort by 'amount owned' to see what you own the least of!)[/i]
[*] 🐱 You now get a notification whenever a piece of equipment[b] breaks[/b].
[*] 🐱 Added a button to [b]show walls[/b] in Decorate mode, so you can easily move / remove windows and doors.
[*] 🐱 The shops now show [b]how many[/b] of an item you already have in your inventory.
[*] Added a line in the shop clarifying that a Stat won't get added when you already have one of that piece of furniture in your cafe [i](duplicates don't add stats, except for Cat Needs like Toy & Food, and Toilets for customers)[/i].
[*] Explanation in the reward screen when you get a Stray Lure as a present, that it is, in fact, a Lure.
[*] 🐱 You can now [b]skip the customer count[/b] at the end of the day by clicking.
[*] 🐱 Fixed some readability issues in the Forever Home rewards.
[*] Improved how traits are displayed, especially when you have a lot of traits.
[*] Added some more indicators for controls to the Decorate Mode.
[*] 🐱 Serving food Tasks are now yellow instead of orange, so you can more easily see which Customers are waiting for orders to be delivered.
[/list]
[h2]BALANCE[/h2]
[list]
[*] Kitchen tasks now spawn at the [b]closest possible kitchen appliance[/b], instead of randomly, better allowing for multiple kitchens.
[*] 🐱 Customers with a "Comfort" need now automatically pick the [b]most comfortable free chair[/b] available.
[*] Staff now prioritizes rarer tasks like maintenance, cat care and cleaning, if they're able to perform those.
[*] Made almost all traits a little [b]more effective[/b].
[*] 🐱 End of the game story now triggers when the shrine is actually fully completed.
[/list]
[h2]FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some traits not applying their bonus correctly.
[*] Fixed some stats overlapping in the UI.
[*] 🐱 Fixed a few bugs related to relationship levels not displaying correctly.
[*] 🐱 Fixed the Cat HUD in the lower right sometimes shifting left and hiding cats when you had a lot of cats.
[*] 🐱 Fixed dialogue skipping when you were holding down a button when the dialogue popped up.
[/list]
If you have any questions about the update, be sure to fire away at us on our [b][url=https://discord.gg/5dCbC895hs]Discord[/url][/b] or the [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1354830/discussions/]Steam forum[/url][/b]! We'll try to answer asap!

Thanks!!
- Rick

notes.title: Patch 1.0.406: New staff members!
notes.notes:
Hey all! Hope you're all having a great week! We have a new patch for you, probably the last one before the big [b]upcoming Quality of Life update[/b]! Not many changes, but one big one: additional staff members for after the end of the story! To make managing that massive cafe a little easier 🙂

Patch notes for 1.0.406:

- Added five additional staff members when you unlock the extra staff slots at the end of the game AND if you've hired all previous staff (should also unlock for existing save files)
- Fixed Forever Home achievements not unlocking correctly if the cat's stat was too high
- Fixed a crash when pressing the right mouse button at very specific moments during dialogue
- Fixed a crash caused by tasks not saving properly in some cases
- Fixed cats sometimes getting stuck in a non-productive state
- Fixed hipster stove not counting towards the amount of hipster furniture in your cafe
- Added some feedback for when staff can't pathfind to a task

notes.title: Patch 1.0.401
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello fellow cat enthusiasts![/h1]
Another week, another patch! This one's a bit more sizable, and fixes some crashes as well as some other common complaints. In the meantime, we're hard at work to fix some issues that require a bit more work: don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/uNhAYFV6KH]Discord[/url] to be notified whenever our next patch goes into beta! If you run into any new bugs, please join our [url=https://discord.gg/uNhAYFV6KH]Discord[/url] and go to #take-a-ticket to make an official bug report. 😸

Patch notes for 1.0.401-windows:
- The missing floors/wallpapers added in the previous patch are now also available in older save games
- Fixed two crashes that sometimes occurred at the end of the day if there had been a lot of customers
- Fixed a crash when buying items in shops too fast
- Fixed bug in Forever Home achievements where stat bonuses awarded by Traits were not taken into account for the achievement requirements
- Fixed some bar furniture not counting towards the A Pint at the Winchester achievement
- Disabled recipe selection functionality, since it was confusing a lot of players. We're working on a more elegant solution that better communicates the recipe mechanic.
- Fixed cat toy need display being wrong in build mode
- Fixed floors/walls being repurchasable (might still happen in ongoing save games)
- Fixed some tasks being able to pile up (such as calling regulars, petting cats, cleaning litterboxes) (existing tasks in save games are not removed)
- Fixed the recipe limit being one too low for all recipes in the game
- Set the staff limit back to six while we get the additional staff members ready (it's coming! very soon!)

notes.notes:

We are still working hard to squash all of the bugs that have already been reported. notes.title: Dev Diary 3 (5/22) Exciting Changes and Announcements
notes.notes:
[i]Join our [url=discord.gg/sAXW2mx ]discord[/url] to hear about new Dev Diaries as soon as they go up![/i]

[h1]Hello dearest cat enthusiast![/h1]
It’s been a while, hasn’t it? We've been real hard at work on Cat Cafe Manager and we've got a few exciting developments to talk about!

[h3]First and foremost,[b] Cat Cafe Manager is going to be apart of Wholesome Direct![/b][/h3]
Tune in on Saturday June 12th, at 1 pm EST to see all the wholesome games, including Cat Cafe Manager! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/f133f3c4bcb677ec074e8bb80366d0ca4dbe4b49.png[/img]

[h2]New Cats, Lures, Traits, and UI! Oh My! [/h2]
Some of our biggest improvements since the last update have been on our loveable cats and how you get those cats. 
We've added 5 new cats, like Lazy, a sleepy Norwegian Forest cat, or Mingus, who is definitely a cat and not just a raccoon that broke into the cat cafe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/ac9ccac1046e34f849d5f99a813a400c094dcdc1.png[/img]
[i]Most definitely not a raccoon. Just your average cat in a cat cafe heh *looks around nervously*
[/i]
We've also made a whole bunch of personality traits for your cats and staff which affect their stats and behaviors. A cat might be a ‘groomer’ that cleans up other cats, a ‘hunter’ that finds its own food and doesn’t have to be fed, or a ‘chonker’ who eats more than most but is extra cute because of it.

With this, there is now an expanded ‘lure’ system: lures are placed outside of your cafe and used to win the trust of stray cats. There’s now more than 10, and each lures in different stray cats for you to win over. The rarest ones are extra weird!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/183aaac7ac8e71d5f9ef1530ad1f9a6d65a6de58.png[/img]
[i]What sort of cat could possibly be lured in by a chunk of fallen meteorite?[/i]

There's also a new 'Advertising’ interface, which allows you to put up advertising to control which types of customers visit. Different customer types pay in different resources, so use this wisely to earn what you need to meet your goals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/2cd20fc795772b5b758060614195dcef6c409342.png[/img]
[i]Want to expand your cafe? Advertise to ‘punks’, who pay in ‘materials’ needed for construction.[/i]

[h3]Some other small updates: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Working with our new audio partner and hearing the first pieces of Cat Cafe Manager music! Nothing to show off just yet, but very exciting nonetheless.
[*] You can now rotate all your props and decorations: giving you even more control over the look and feel of your cat cafe.
[*] Worked on improving the control scheme for the game, allowing you to run around the cafe, pet cats and serve your customers much more smoothly and directly.
[*] Created a new UI celebrating when you earn new rewards, such as receiving a present from a friend or adopting a new cat. This is also where you get to name your newly adopted cats.
[/list]
For now, I hope you'll continue to look forward to Cat Cafe Manager! Don't forget to wishlist the game, if you haven't already and share with your friends!
Thanks for reading!

Roost Games’ Rick
